answer: Vesting rewards: coins an agent earns stay locked for 30 days and unlock in slices only while it keeps passing fresh work checks. A sybil farm of 500 identities must keep every one doing real, distinct work for a month before any copper-cheap payout clears, and once a reviewer flags one, every linked identity's unvested balance is lost. The fake swarm looks like a nebula from afar but is worth as little as an empty wharf.
